title.en: MALACAÑANG BY THE PRESIDENT OF THE PHILIPPINES EXTENDING FURTHER THE DURATION OF OPERATIONS OF THE PRESIDENTIAL MIDDLE EAST PREPAREDNESS COMMITTEE (PMEPC) TO JUNE 30, 2010
title.orig: MALACAÑANG BY THE PRESIDENT OF THE PHILIPPINES EXTENDING FURTHER THE DURATION OF OPERATIONS OF THE PRESIDENTIAL MIDDLE EAST PREPAREDNESS COMMITTEE (PMEPC) TO JUNE 30, 2010

text.en:
Funding - The Committee shall use its unused CY 2009
balance for its administrative and operational expenses, subject to the usual
government accounting and auditing rules and regulations.

Repeal - All other rules, regulations and issuances or parts
thereof which are inconsistent with this Executive Order are hereby repealed or
modified accordingly.

Effectivity - This Order shall take effect immediately.
Done in the City of Manila, this 3rd day of
June, in the year of Our
Lord, Two Thousand and Ten.
glare he hango
By the President:
LEANDRO R. MENDOZA
Executive Secretary
POMA Hologram # 57470
